verdict.rationale: The evidence shows `fly launch` creating, configuring and usually deploying an app from your own source directory. There are also tech-specific docs and blueprints, such as one for remote MCP servers. These are scanners and guides rather than true one-click templates or starters; no template gallery or one-click deploy buttons are documented. Missing for 10: a documented one-click template/starter catalog, deploy-button style starters for common use cases, independent or hands-on corroboration of template-based deploys.
